verdict.summary: Round 5 confirms the prior approval. The enumerate-for-decision call sites consistently bind each requested gh --limit to the same cap used by a saturation guard, fail closed at exactly the ambiguous cap, and include boundary tests that exercise the real call sites as well as the accepted cap-minus-one case. The shell PR-page logic correctly derives cardinality from the JSON array before rendering and normalizes title newlines, avoiding false saturation from multiline titles. The merged-omnibus query remains explicitly scoped as a bounded recency window rather than complete enumeration. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, injection, or security defect in the supplied diff.
